reasons: Classification is correct: the sole cap (p0077) protects only TrueLink, is limited to Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11, and leaves Client's liability — including the very broad one-way indemnity at Section 12a(i)–(iv) — entirely uncapped, which is expressly walk-away territory under LOL-CAP and fails the mutual-cap fallback.

Redline reaches the playbook position: mutual, agreement-wide aggregate cap at the greater of 12 months' hosting/support compensation and USD 1,000,000, with the standard Excluded Claims set (confidentiality/data security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) and confirmation that Client's payment obligations are outside the cap.

The failed minimal-edit heuristic (0.795 changed-character ratio) is acceptable here: converting a one-sided, section-limited Vendor-only cap into a mutual agreement-wide cap with carve-outs necessarily requires rewriting the sentence, and the drafter preserved the original fee basis (hosting and support compensation) and the all-caps formatting rather than replacing the section.
Comment is accurate, appropriately concise, cites the playbook position and explains that indemnities/confidentiality sit outside the cap; it does not misstate the existing text.

Minor, non-fatal gaps noted only: no mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages was added (a preferred-position sub-element the rationale acknowledges), and the cross-references to Sections 5 and 12 should be confirmed against the fee and indemnity sections.
